Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (CET) Remote: Yes (freelance / short projects, EU-US-LATAM hours) Willing to relocate: No Technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, React/Next.js, Python, Java/Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS (Lambda, ECS, RDS), Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, OpenAI/LLM APIs, RAG, MCP, n8n Résumé/CV: on request Email: giovannyh195@gmail.com

Senior full-stack engineer, 8+ years shipping production systems for Volvo Cars, SEB (banking) and Blackboard. Available for short, well-scoped freelance work: building an MVP or a feature, fixing a stuck deployment, setting up AWS infra with Terraform and CI/CD, integrating LLMs into an existing product (RAG, agents, MCP servers), or getting a messy codebase back under control. I deliver in small working increments and document what I hand over. I also build and run my own SaaS in production. Spanish native, English professional.
